caveats: ENEMY-TARGETED STAT LINES ARE ENCODED BUT ENGINE-INERT: resolveTargets({kind:'enemy'}) returns no entity, and the schema has no boss-DEF-debuff channel (defPct is documented as self-DEF, inert in v1). Both DEF ▼ lines (skill1 5.94%, burst 12.34%) are REAL team-wide damage gains in game — they are recorded as blocks per the 'keep the stat buff even if inert' prior, not converted to damageTakenPct, because DEF-subtraction → damage is not a 1:1 percentage map and any conversion factor would be fabricated. Modeling gap, measurement-gated (boss-DEF battery).
The enemy ATK ▼ 5.94% line is defensive-only at scope lock (no incoming damage, no HP pool) and carries no tandem consumer; encoded for kit completeness, permanently 0 damage.

skill2 is a self-lifesteal window with no HP pool in v1 — its ONLY live function is emitting `recovery` events for heal-synergy teammates ('when recovery takes effect'). The ⚑ tick count therefore changes a teammate's proc count, not this unit's damage.

⚑ burst flatDamage takes no explicit noFb: a burstCast-triggered hit resolves before the Full Burst window opens, so the engine's own timing already excludes the +50% major. noFb is left unset (default OFF, measured-only).
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Signal (SMG/Fire/Attacker/Burst II, ammo 120, hitsPerShot 1). Three-line kit, no stacks, no weapon swap, no mode gates, no DoT. skill1 = a per-60-round enemy debuff pair (hitCount:60 counts ROUNDS, not trigger pulls — hitsPerShot 1 so rounds == pulls here); both riders are enemy-scoped and engine-inert (see caveats). skill2 = fullBurstEnter self-lifesteal, modeled as a 10-tick heal-over-time so on-recovery consumers stay fed; trigger is 'entering Full Burst' (any team FB), NOT burstCast — the kit text is literal. burst = a burstCast instant hit at 229.22% of final ATK (crit-eligible at the caster's sheet rate per the rider convention; no core — the text does not say core strike; noRange is engine-automatic and not set) plus a 10 sec enemy DEF ▼ 12.34%. No line was silently dropped; unmodeled is empty because every kit line is represented as a block.

flags.field: base weapon cadence (SMG pulls/sec — not an override field)
flags.estimate: SMG datamined rate_of_fire is NOMINAL; effective = 60/ceil(60/nominal) (e.g. 2.5f → 3f = 20 rounds/s), so the skill1 60-round trigger fires roughly every ~3s, ~2 procs per 120-round magazine
flags.reasoning: rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and this unit's ONLY cadence-gated mechanic (hitCount:60) scales directly with rounds/sec — a cadence error moves the debuff proc rate 1:1
flags.recipe: Focus recording: read the ammo counter across a full magazine (rounds consumed / elapsed sec) — the instrument that measures shots/sec directly, not a downstream FB-count read

flags.estimate: ticks:10, intervalSec:1 over the stated 10 sec window
flags.reasoning: The kit gives a total recovery percentage 'over 10 sec' with NO tick cadence. Real lifesteal is damage-driven, so recovery events could fire per landed hit (~20/s) rather than once per second; the engine models no HP, so the only observable consequence is how many `recovery` triggers a heal-synergy ally receives. 1/sec is the schema's documented HoT convention, chosen as the conservative estimate rather than a guessed per-hit rate
flags.recipe: Run with a heal-consumer teammate whose on-recovery buff is popup/uptime-visible; count that ally's proc/refresh events across one Full Burst window in footage and compare against 10 vs ~200 events

flags.estimate: 0 damage in the current engine; true in-game gain is a boss-DEF reduction of 5.94% (5s, per 60 rounds) and 12.34% (10s, per own burst), whose damage value depends on the boss DEF / team ATK ratio and is NOT a 5.94%/12.34% damage increase
flags.reasoning: No StatKey expresses an enemy DEF debuff, and enemy targets resolve to no entity. Converting to damageTakenPct would fabricate a magnitude, because DEF enters the formula as a subtraction, not as a damage multiplier — the conversion factor is exactly the unmeasured quantity
flags.recipe: Boss-DEF battery: solo the unit with and without the debuff active (compare per-shot popup values inside vs outside the 5s window on a focus recording) to derive the effective damage delta per 1% boss DEF; then either add a bossDefPct channel or pin the measured multiplier

flags.reasoning: Rider convention: function-damage riders crit at the caster's rate but take no core unless the text says 'core strike damage' — this line says neither, so crit is convention-driven rather than kit-stated
flags.recipe: Popup colour read on the burst nuke (orange + crit icon vs white) across several casts in a focus recording; a red CORE HIT tag would additionally refute core:false
